tasks.title: Expose a read-only adapter summary and protect terminal behavior
tasks.objective: Provide IF-1 through the existing adapter, verify the already implemented terminal report output, and preserve pre-change legacy rendering references.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Provisional estimate for one adapter helper, terminal assertions, and deterministic legacy references including local verification. Source inspection establishes the boundaries; no comparable execution history is available.

complexity.justification: The adapter must translate typed loading failures while reusing analysis and preserving an existing terminal contract.

scope.justification: Summary access fits within the existing adapter and test files without changing report algorithms or CLI routing.

duration.justification: Existing integration fixtures reduce setup work, but output assertions and legacy references require an estimated verification pass.
evidence: assumption:The 100-minute estimate has no comparable execution-history samples

risk.justification: An incorrect adapter result could mislead plan review or obscure terminal failures despite leaving approval code unchanged.

coupling.justification: T2 and T3 consume the plan-quality-summary-contract and legacy references produced by this adapter task.

confidence.justification: Adapter routing, validated loading, analysis output, and test helpers were inspected, but the new checks remain unexecuted.

acceptance_criteria: quality_summary accepts a requirement directory and returns exactly the IF-1 availability contract

New test setup isolates filesystem roots before importing application modules

verification.purpose: Assert terminal JSON output and exit codes, adapter analysis values, and typed availability outcomes using isolated fixtures

interfaces.title: Read-only adapter quality summary
inputs: Requirement directory containing an optional PLAN.json
outputs: quality_summary returns a dictionary with availability, summary, and error_code
availability is absent for PLAN_NOT_FOUND, available after successful validation and analysis, or unavailable for other expected planner loading and validation errors
summary contains the unchanged quality.analyze dictionary only when available and is null otherwise
error_code contains a stable planner error code only when unavailable and is null otherwise
invariants: Only the adapter imports planner functionality on behalf of methodology consumers
Analysis reuses the existing validated plan and quality algorithm without parsing CLI output
Missing files never produce summary markup and unavailable data never produces fabricated metric values
No workspace lookup, subprocess, persisted cache, approval, freeze, launch, or state mutation is introduced
Terminal report JSON and exit behavior remain unchanged
Estimated minutes and declared evidence are not represented as measured execution or verified acceptance
integration_criteria: CLI and web values match the expected branching fixture with critical path T1 then T2 at 90 minutes, widest level 2, and low-confidence list T3
Unavailable errors are rendered without raw diagnostics or filesystem paths
Absent PLAN.json reproduces captured legacy HTML across statuses
Reporting and rendering preserve requirement, revision, and run-state bytes
